domains.description: Intelligent AI agents designed to streamline retail operations and elevate customer experiences. From inventory optimization to personalized shopping, these solutions drive efficiency and boost sales.

use_cases.title: Automated Customer Service
use_cases.description: Virtual assistant that answers customer queries and resolves common service requests (order status, return policy, store hours) automatically.
key_features: 24/7 customer query resolution
Order tracking and status updates
Policy information automation
Multi-channel support integration
use_cases.impact: Reduces customer service costs by 60%, improves response times, and increases customer satisfaction.

use_cases.title: Consumer Intelligence Agent
use_cases.description: Production-grade AI platform for continuous monitoring, analysis, and autonomous response to consumer feedback across digital channels. The system currently ingests product reviews through SerpAPI (Google Shopping reviews), leverages RAG-based knowledge retrieval for deep feedback analysis, and enables natural-language-to-SQL querying over structured consumer and product datasets to generate actionable business insights.
key_features: Continuous collection of consumer feedback from online sources
SerpAPI integration for Google Shopping review monitoring
RAG-powered semantic analysis of customer feedback
Natural-language querying over structured databases
Sentiment analysis and trend identification
Automated insight generation and feedback summarization
Unified search across unstructured reviews and structured data
Scalable architecture for multi-channel feedback expansion
use_cases.impact: Enables retailers and product teams to understand customer sentiment in real time, identify emerging product issues, uncover market trends, and make data-driven decisions faster. By combining RAG-based review intelligence with natural-language analytics, the platform reduces manual analysis effort and accelerates customer-centric product improvements.

use_cases.title: Monday Morning Agent
use_cases.description: Intelligent business intelligence agent that delivers automated weekly metric reports and real-time data insights to user inboxes. Enables executives and teams to subscribe to custom business questions, receive schedulable reports (daily, weekly, monthly) with professional formatting, and query metrics on-demand in plain English. Integrates with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, and Outlook to provide instant data-driven insights without manual report preparation.
key_features: Metric subscription and custom question configuration
Flexible scheduling (daily, weekly, monthly reporting)
Automated email report delivery with professional formatting
Plain English query interface for instant metrics
Data visualization with charts, graphs, and tables
Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams integration
Cross-platform support (desktop, web, and mobile)
No manual report generation or data compilation required
Real-time metric retrieval and aggregation
Customizable business intelligence dashboards
use_cases.impact: Eliminates manual reporting overhead, ensures executives receive critical metrics automatically on schedule, enables data-driven decision-making, reduces time spent gathering business intelligence, provides instant answers to ad-hoc queries, improves visibility into key performance indicators, and streamlines business intelligence distribution across teams.

use_cases.title: Style Crew Agent
use_cases.description: AI agent that provides personalized fashion recommendations and curated outfit suggestions by understanding user preferences, seasonal trends, and product catalog data. It enables conversational shopping experiences by guiding users through categories, suggesting complete looks, and facilitating seamless product discovery and purchase.
key_features: Conversational product discovery based on user intent (e.g., season, occasion, gender)
Personalized outfit recommendations combining multiple products into complete looks
Dynamic category suggestions (e.g., summer essentials, accessories, casual/formal wear)
Real-time product recommendations with pricing and add-to-cart actions
Multi-step interaction flow for refining style preferences and options
Cross-selling and upselling through complementary product suggestions
Visual product browsing integrated within chat interface
Context-aware memory of previous queries and styling preferences
use_cases.impact: Enhances customer engagement through interactive shopping experiences, increases conversion rates via personalized recommendations, boosts average order value through outfit bundling and cross-selling, reduces decision fatigue for users, and delivers a seamless blend of conversational AI with e-commerce navigation.

use_cases.title: Smart Store Agent
use_cases.description: Multi-stage supply chain intelligence platform orchestrating shipment tracking, driver location intelligence, route optimization, and supplier performance analysis. Combines classification, data retrieval, and conversational response generation in a specialized graph architecture. Monitors real-time logistics operations, predicts delivery risks, and optimizes fleet efficiency.
key_features: Shipment status tracking and visibility
Driver location and route optimization
Real-time disruption detection and risk prediction
Supplier performance rating and reliability analysis
Multi-leg shipment journey tracking
Context-pruned data delivery to prevent prompt bloat
Count-only query optimization
Professional narrative generation from structured logistics data
use_cases.impact: Enables proactive logistics management, reduces delivery delays through real-time visibility, optimizes driver routes for cost savings, identifies at-risk shipments before failures, improves supplier relationships through performance transparency, and reduces customer escalations.

use_cases.title: WPP Pricing Optimizer & Market Intelligence Agent
use_cases.description: AI agent that generates optimal product pricing recommendations by analyzing demand elasticity, competitive market dynamics, and scenario-based pricing strategies. Uses game-theoretic modeling to predict competitor responses and balance revenue, margin, and volume objectives.
key_features: Multi-scenario demand forecasting with price elasticity modeling
Competitive price intelligence and market positioning analysis
Game-theoretic competitor response prediction
Optimal price recommendation with margin/volume tradeoff analysis
Inventory feasibility and stock constraint optimization
Anomaly detection in demand patterns and pricing outliers
Cross-product performance correlation analysis
Governance compliance and contract rule enforcement
use_cases.impact: Maximizes revenue and margin through AI-driven pricing, reduces pricing errors and margin erosion, enables rapid what-if scenario analysis, identifies cross-sell opportunities, minimizes inventory risk, and provides executive-grade competitive intelligence for strategic pricing decisions.

use_cases.title: Automated Product Tag Generator
use_cases.description: AI agent that auto-generates meaningful product tags (e.g., Organic, Gluten-Free, Vegan) from product descriptions to improve discoverability.
key_features: Intelligent tag extraction
Nutritional information analysis
Category-based tagging
Search optimization enhancement
use_cases.impact: Improves product discoverability by 45%, reduces manual tagging effort, and enhances customer search experience.

use_cases.title: Fraud & Anomaly Detection Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered retail fraud and anomaly detection platform that analyzes transaction data to identify suspicious activities, operational irregularities, and risk patterns. Built using Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure OpenAI, FastAPI, React, and embedding-based document intelligence to combine transactional analysis with business context for explainable fraud detection.
key_features: Automated fraud and anomaly detection across retail transaction datasets
AI-powered retail analytics agent for investigative querying and root-cause analysis
Document intelligence pipeline for incorporating business policies and operational context
Embedding-based semantic search for contextual anomaly explanations
Real-time analysis of suspicious transactions and operational deviations
Interactive dashboard for anomaly exploration and risk monitoring
Chat-based investigation workflow powered by Azure OpenAI
use_cases.impact: Improves retail risk management by proactively identifying fraudulent activities, uncovering operational anomalies, accelerating investigations, and providing explainable AI-driven insights that help teams reduce losses and improve decision-making.

use_cases.title: Loyalty & Newsletter Enrollment Agent
use_cases.description: Conversational AI agent that guides customers through loyalty program and newsletter enrollment using Google Gemini 1.5 Flash and a RAG-based knowledge retrieval system. Detects enrollment intent from natural language, manages a multi-step enrollment flow (intent detection → detail collection → confirmation → completion), and surfaces a contextual enrollment form mid-conversation. Backed by a FastAPI backend with session management, real-time analytics tracking, and a vanilla JS frontend.
key_features: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash with chain-of-thought reasoning and RAG knowledge base retrieval for accurate, context-aware responses
Dual enrollment support — loyalty program (points, discounts, birthday rewards) and newsletter (weekly deals, early access) — individually or together
Multi-step enrollment state machine: initial request → collecting details → confirming → completed, with session persistence
Keyword-scored RAG search across a prioritized knowledge base with category-tagged FAQ items and fallback handling
Real-time analytics dashboard tracking conversations, enrollments, conversion funnel, response times, and estimated ROI
Enrollment intent detection from natural language with confirmation handling mid-conversation and contextual form injection
Pydantic-validated enrollment with email, phone, and name validation plus welcome bonus and next-steps in the response payload
use_cases.impact: Automates customer enrollment conversations end-to-end — from first question to signed-up member — reducing manual agent effort, improving enrollment conversion rates, and providing live analytics visibility into funnel performance.

use_cases.title: Personalization Engine
use_cases.description: AI agent that personalizes a shopper's online experience by recommending products based on browsing or purchase history.
key_features: Behavioral pattern analysis
Purchase history insights
Real-time recommendation engine
Cross-selling optimization
use_cases.impact: Increases conversion rates by 35%, improves average order value, and enhances customer experience.

use_cases.title: Product Discovery Bot
use_cases.description: Website chatbot that helps customers explore products (ratings, reviews, launch dates, trending items).
key_features: Interactive product exploration
Review and rating integration
Trending product identification
Personalized discovery assistance
use_cases.impact: Improves product discovery, increases time on site, and boosts sales conversion rates.

use_cases.title: Planogram Compliance Agent
use_cases.description: AI agent that uses image recognition to check shelf layouts against planograms and flags misplaced or missing SKUs for store associates.
key_features: Image recognition technology
Planogram compliance checking
Misplacement detection
Real-time store associate alerts
use_cases.impact: Improves planogram compliance by 80%, optimizes product visibility, and increases sales effectiveness.

use_cases.title: Voice FAQ Agent
use_cases.description: Voice agent that answers common FAQs (policy, HR, IT) using RAG over a provided document set.
key_features: Voice-enabled query processing
RAG-based knowledge retrieval
Multi-domain FAQ coverage
Natural language response generation
use_cases.impact: Reduces support ticket volume, provides 24/7 assistance, and improves employee self-service capabilities.

use_cases.title: Hiring Support Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered hiring assistant built on the Microsoft Agentic Framework (MAF) and Azure OpenAI. Orchestrates three specialized agents — an InterviewQuestionGenerator, a ResumeScreener, and a HiringSupportOrchestrator — to automate the full recruitment workflow: from parsing job descriptions and generating structured interview questions, to objectively scoring and ranking candidate resumes (PDF, DOCX, TXT) across five weighted criteria. Exposed via a FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend.
key_features: InterviewQuestionGenerator agent produces categorized questions (Technical, Behavioral, Competency, Cultural Fit) tailored to role seniority
ResumeScreener agent scores candidates 0–100 across 5 weighted criteria: Skills Match, Experience Relevance, Education, Achievements, and Role Fit
Structured JSON output per candidate with score breakdown, top 3 strengths, top 3 gaps, and a fit recommendation (STRONG / GOOD / PARTIAL / NOT A FIT)
Multi-format resume ingestion: PDF (PyPDF2), DOCX (python-docx), and plain text in a single batch API call
HiringSupportOrchestrator for open-ended role analysis and conversational hiring Q&A
Full-workflow endpoint combining question generation and resume screening in one API call
MAF Agent framework with Azure OpenAI GPT-4o — all three agents share a single client factory with no direct OpenAI SDK calls
use_cases.impact: Eliminates hours of manual resume screening and ad-hoc interview preparation. Delivers consistent, bias-reduced candidate evaluations with structured scoring and ranked shortlists — enabling hiring teams to focus on high-value interviews rather than administrative triage.

use_cases.title: Enterprise Knowledge Bot
use_cases.description: A Flask-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that unifies enterprise knowledge across multiple data sources. Uses a dual-agent architecture — a local FAISS agent for uploaded documents and an Azure AI Search agent for external knowledge bases — orchestrated via Semantic Kernel. Supports 7 document formats, three LLM providers (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini), and optional integrations with Microsoft Fabric and Excel data, all surfaced through a modern web chat UI with citations and confidence scores.
key_features: Dual RAG agents: local FAISS vector index for uploaded docs + Azure AI Search for external knowledge bases
Semantic Kernel orchestrator that merges, ranks, and synthesises results from all active agents
Multi-format document ingestion: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, XLSX, Markdown, and plain text
Multi-LLM flexibility: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o), and Google Gemini — switchable from the UI
Microsoft Fabric agent for live data warehouse and lakehouse querying via OAuth2 client credentials
Excel/CSV agent with TF-IDF similarity search for structured tabular data queries
Citation support with confidence scores, background indexing progress tracking, and conversation memory
use_cases.impact: Gives enterprise teams a single conversational interface to query across all their document repositories, structured data, and cloud knowledge bases — eliminating manual document search and reducing time-to-insight for knowledge workers dealing with large, multi-format information stores.

use_cases.title: AgentMart
use_cases.description: Agentic AI platform for e-commerce that optimizes product recommendations, stock forecasting, and customer interactions. Leverages AI to drive conversions through dynamic recommendations, proactive cart recovery, and autonomous marketing campaigns.
key_features: AI-driven personalized product recommendations
Proactive cart abandonment recovery
Predictive inventory and stock forecasting
Autonomous campaign recommendations and promotions
Real-time order delay notifications
AI-powered review summaries
use_cases.impact: Increases purchase rates through proactive engagement, reduces manual workload for inventory and marketing teams, and improves shopping satisfaction through real-time updates and personalized experiences.

domains.description: AI-powered agents built to enhance patient care and optimize clinical workflows. These solutions support healthcare teams in delivering safer, more efficient operations.
AI agents that automate financial processes and strengthen compliance controls. They help teams manage risk, reduce errors, and accelerate document-heavy workflows.

use_cases.title: Invoice Extraction Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered agentic pipeline that extracts structured invoice data from PDFs and converts it into LEDES 98B and LEDES XML 2.1 legal billing formats. Uses Microsoft AutoGen (MAF) multi-agent framework with Azure OpenAI — an ExtractorAgent, ValidatorAgent, and LEDESMapperAgent — backed by a FastAPI backend and React frontend for upload, review, editing, and download.
key_features: Multi-agent pipeline: Extractor → Validator → LEDESMapper agents via Microsoft AutoGen
PDF text extraction using pdfplumber and PyPDF2 with OCR fallback
Structured invoice field extraction with AI-based validation and correction
Automatic LEDES code mapping (L-codes, A-codes, E-codes) from line item descriptions
LEDES 98B (pipe-delimited) and LEDES XML 2.1 output generation
React + Vite frontend for upload, agent log monitoring, inline editing, and download
FastAPI REST backend with async job store and full Swagger UI
use_cases.impact: Eliminates manual data entry and LEDES code assignment in legal billing workflows. Automates extraction of invoice fields, validates totals and dates, and produces audit-ready LEDES outputs in seconds — reducing turnaround time for e-billing submissions and minimizing compliance errors.

use_cases.title: Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent (VIRA)
use_cases.description: AI-powered accounts payable platform that extracts invoice, purchase order, and contract data, performs intelligent 3-way reconciliation, detects fraud risks, and ensures contract compliance through AI-driven validation and workflow automation.
key_features: Automated data extraction from invoices, purchase orders, and contracts
Intelligent 3-way reconciliation (Invoice ↔ PO ↔ Contract)
AI-powered discrepancy detection and explanations
Contract compliance validation using RAG
Duplicate invoice and fraud risk detection
Human-in-the-loop approval workflow
Role-based access control and audit trails
Real-time dashboard with reconciliation insights
use_cases.impact: VIRA reduces manual invoice reconciliation effort by over 90%, improves compliance through contract-aware validation, accelerates accounts payable processing, minimizes fraud risks, and provides a complete audit trail for finance operations.

use_cases.title: Invoice PO Matching Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered procurement validation solution that automatically matches supplier invoices against purchase orders to identify discrepancies, assess financial risk, and generate actionable recommendations. Built using a multi-agent workflow with Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAI, with a deterministic fallback engine for offline execution.
key_features: Automated invoice-to-purchase-order matching
Header-level validation for invoice number, dates, and totals
Line-item comparison for quantity, unit price, and total amount mismatches
Detection of missing, extra, or inconsistent invoice lines
Procurement risk scoring based on discrepancy severity
AI-generated narratives explaining identified issues
Business-focused recommendations for corrective actions
Multi-agent workflow using Extraction, Comparison, and Report agents
CSV and Excel document processing support
Interactive Streamlit dashboard for review and analysis
use_cases.impact: Reduces manual invoice auditing effort by automatically identifying discrepancies between invoices and purchase orders. Improves procurement accuracy, accelerates invoice validation, minimizes payment errors, and provides risk-based recommendations for finance and procurement teams.

use_cases.title: Loan Underwriting Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered loan underwriting platform built with Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAI. Uses a coordinated team of specialized underwriting agents to evaluate creditworthiness, verify income, assess collateral risk, enforce lending policies, calculate financial ratios, and generate final loan approval recommendations through an auditable multi-step workflow.
key_features: End-to-end automated loan underwriting workflow
Policy gate with fail-fast underwriting rule validation
Credit profile analysis and risk tier classification
Income verification and affordability assessment
Property appraisal and collateral risk evaluation
Debt-to-Income (DTI) and Loan-to-Value (LTV) calculations
Composite risk scoring and regulatory compliance checks
AI-generated underwriting rationale and decision reports
FastAPI backend with React-based frontend
Azure OpenAI powered multi-agent decision framework
use_cases.impact: Accelerates loan approval processes by automating underwriting analysis across credit, income, and property dimensions. Improves consistency of lending decisions, reduces manual review effort, enforces policy compliance, and provides transparent decision explanations for financial institutions.

use_cases.title: POE Scanner
use_cases.description: AI-powered Proof of Expense (POE) document processor that automates receipt data extraction, validation, and categorization using a multi-agent Semantic Kernel pipeline. Accepts PDF uploads, file paths, or raw receipt text — running them through a configurable sequence of DocumentProcessor, FieldExtractor, DataValidator, and ResultFormatter agents backed by FAISS vector search for intelligent vendor recognition and expense categorization.
key_features: Multi-agent pipeline orchestrated via Semantic Kernel AgentGroupChat with YAML-configurable agents
FAISS vector index with 200+ vendors for AI-powered vendor recognition and smart expense categorization
Multi-format input support: PDF upload, local file path, or direct receipt text
Multi-language and multi-currency detection (English, German, Indian formats; $, €, Rs)
Onboarding Copilot agent for guided, conversational expense submission flows
Streamlit frontend with Flask REST API backend for real-time processing and ERP integration
Semantic Kernel plugins for PDF processing, field extraction, and AI-driven data enrichment
use_cases.impact: Eliminates manual receipt data entry and categorization errors in enterprise expense workflows. Cuts per-receipt processing time from ~10 minutes to under 1 minute, improves extraction accuracy from 80% to 95%, and delivers a RESTful API that plugs directly into ERP and finance systems.

use_cases.title: Market Intelligence & Pricing Agent
use_cases.description: AI agent that benchmarks insurance rates, predicts claim trends, and monitors competitor/regulatory filings to guide smarter pricing strategies.
key_features: Competitive rate benchmarking
Predictive trend analysis
Regulatory filing monitoring
Dynamic pricing recommendations
use_cases.impact: Improves pricing competitiveness, reduces risk exposure, and increases profitability through data-driven decisions.

use_cases.title: Expense Forecaster
use_cases.description: AI agent that predicts next quarter/month expenses using historical data and seasonal patterns.
key_features: Predictive expense modeling
Seasonal pattern recognition
Budget variance analysis
Automated forecasting reports
use_cases.impact: Improves budget accuracy by 30%, enables proactive cost management, and supports strategic planning decisions.

use_cases.title: Executive Copilot Agent
use_cases.description: Intelligent Business Intelligence Platform - a FastAPI app that combines a frontend with agent-powered Executive Q&A, Document analysis, and Board Narrative generation.
key_features: Executive-level query processing
Cross-functional report summarization
Board presentation generation
Data-driven narrative creation
use_cases.impact: Reduces executive reporting preparation time, improves strategic insights, and enhances board communication.

use_cases.title: Code Standards Reviewer Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered code review platform that runs a three-stage multi-agent pipeline — Static Analyst, Remediation Specialist, and Senior Architect — to automatically detect issues, generate actionable fixes, and deliver architectural feedback on Python source code. Static analysis (ruff, bandit, radon) feeds findings to the Remediation and Senior Architect agents running in parallel via asyncio, with results surfaced through a React + Vite frontend featuring a real-time agent activity feed, health score ring, and tabbed results view.
key_features: Three-agent pipeline: StaticAnalyst → RemediationSpecialist + SeniorArchitect (parallel asyncio.gather) → FinalReport
Static analysis via ruff (linting), bandit (security), and radon (cyclomatic complexity + maintainability index)
LLM-powered RemediationSpecialist generates per-finding fix code, explanation, and fix description for every static issue
SeniorArchitect agent reads project-specific coding standards (async patterns, error handling, FastAPI, type hinting, naming) and produces holistic suggestions that avoid duplicating static findings
Structured Pydantic models across every agent boundary — Finding, EnrichedFinding, Metrics, FinalReport — with letter grades and an overall health score (0–100)
Real-time AgentActivityFeed, circular HealthScoreRing gauge, syntax-highlighted CodeBlock, and tabbed results (Overview / Findings / Metrics / Senior Review) in the React frontend
FastAPI backend with versioned API, async subprocess runner for tool execution, and structured logging
use_cases.impact: Gives development teams an automated senior reviewer that catches linting issues, security vulnerabilities, and complexity hotspots — and immediately provides fix suggestions and architectural guidance — reducing manual code review time and raising baseline code quality consistently across every submission.

use_cases.title: Expense Trend Analyzer
use_cases.description: AI-powered expense analytics platform built on Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF). Uses specialized agents for financial metrics computation, spending trend analysis, anomaly detection, category breakdowns, and recommendation generation. Combines statistical analysis with Azure OpenAI-powered insights through an interactive Streamlit dashboard.
key_features: Multi-agent architecture using Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)
Automated expense metrics calculation (total, average, median, spend count)
Spending trend detection using linear regression analysis
Anomaly detection with Z-score statistical modeling
Category-wise expense breakdown and distribution analysis
AI-generated financial insights and spending recommendations
Interactive Streamlit dashboard with filters and visualizations
CSV upload support with configurable date, category, and granularity filters
Azure OpenAI GPT-4o integration for narrative analysis
Expense trend monitoring across daily, weekly, and monthly periods
use_cases.impact: Enables users to understand spending behavior, identify unusual transactions, monitor expense trends, and receive AI-generated financial recommendations. Reduces manual analysis effort by combining statistical techniques with intelligent insights generation in a single dashboard experience.

domains.description: AI agents focused on optimizing production lines and maintaining quality standards. These solutions improve operational visibility and workforce efficiency across the factory floor.

use_cases.title: CIP — Active Production Monitoring
use_cases.description: Supervisor-facing production monitoring and decision-support platform that combines a deterministic KPI engine with an agent narration layer to turn shop-floor signals into ranked actions, auditable decisions, and role-based operational dashboards.
key_features: Deterministic engine for snapshot, daily output, risk, monitoring, OT, level loading, and coordination
Human-in-the-loop decision gate with confirm / override / reject flow and full audit trail
Smart Work List that merges multiple operational views into one ranked action feed
Role-based production dashboard with supervisor, planner, line lead, ME, and admin access
AI narration layer that explains risks and recommendations without changing the underlying scoring
Dual database mode with cloud Supabase/PostgreSQL or embedded DuckDB for offline runs
Graceful fallback to mock LLM and offline fixtures when external services are unavailable
use_cases.impact: Reduces context switching by consolidating production health, prediction, and decision workflows into one auditable cockpit. The deterministic core keeps scoring consistent, while the human gate ensures every applied action is reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Inventory Overview Agent (IOA)
use_cases.description: AI-powered multi-agent inventory management system built on the Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF). A top-level InventoryOrchestrator routes natural language queries to three specialized sub-agents — StockAgent, ProcurementAgent, and AnalyticsAgent — each equipped with @tool-decorated functions that query a live Supabase PostgreSQL backend. Surfaced through a Streamlit chat UI with persistent in-session conversation memory.
key_features: MAF agent-as-tool pattern: sub-agents registered as callable tools on the orchestrator — no manual routing logic
StockAgent for real-time low-stock detection, stockout prediction, and shipment delay monitoring
ProcurementAgent for supplier lookup with lead times and automated purchase order creation
AnalyticsAgent for warehouse utilisation summaries, trend analysis, and stock health scoring
Supabase PostgreSQL backend with 7 normalized tables covering products, warehouses, suppliers, POs, and stock movements
Persistent in-session conversation memory with context builder for multi-turn natural language queries
Streamlit chat UI with dark theme, sidebar critical alerts, and one-command local setup
use_cases.impact: Transforms manual inventory monitoring into a conversational AI experience. Enables warehouse and procurement teams to instantly detect low-stock risks, predict stockouts, and raise purchase orders through plain English — eliminating context-switching across spreadsheets and ERP screens.

use_cases.title: Vendor Receipt Scanner
use_cases.description: AI-powered invoice and receipt processing pipeline built on the Microsoft Agent Framework. Implements a four-node typed workflow — ExtractNode, ParseNode, ValidateNode, StorageNode — where each node is a dedicated MAF agent with registered tools. Processed receipts are persisted in SQLite and indexed in a FAISS vector store for semantic search, with a separate ProcurementValidationAgent cross-checking invoices against purchase order data. Surfaced through a FastAPI backend and a React + Vite frontend.
key_features: Four-node MAF workflow: Extract (PDF/OCR) → Parse → Validate → Storage, each node backed by a dedicated agent with registered tools
ProcurementValidationAgent cross-references extracted invoice fields against PO CSV data with multi-currency and fuzzy vendor name matching
FAISS vector index with configurable embedding providers (Sentence Transformers or Azure OpenAI) for semantic receipt search
SQLite persistence with duplicate detection and structured JSON receipt storage
Tesseract OCR fallback for image-based receipts alongside native PDF text extraction
Graceful degradation: every MAF node falls back to direct Python execution if the framework or env vars are unavailable
React + Vite frontend with FastAPI backend, supporting upload, listing, detail view, and semantic search over stored receipts
use_cases.impact: Automates end-to-end vendor invoice intake — from raw PDF or image upload through field extraction, PO reconciliation, and searchable storage — eliminating manual data entry and mismatch errors in procurement workflows.

domains.description: AI agents that streamline contract management, legal research, and compliance tracking. They help legal teams work faster while reducing risk and improving accuracy.

use_cases.title: GDPR Compliance Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered GDPR Right-to-Be-Forgotten compliance platform that automates identity verification, PII discovery, data processing, audit reporting, and compliance monitoring. Built using Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), Azure OpenAI, FAISS vector search, FastAPI, and Streamlit to orchestrate end-to-end privacy workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
key_features: End-to-end GDPR Right-to-Be-Forgotten workflow automation
Multi-agent architecture using Microsoft Agent Framework
AI-driven identity verification and compliance validation
PII discovery across SQL, CSV, JSON, and document repositories
FAISS vector search for semantic PII retrieval
Automated mask, delete, and flag processing actions
Audit trail generation and compliance reporting dashboard
use_cases.impact: Accelerates GDPR compliance operations by automating data subject request handling, reducing manual review effort, improving audit readiness, and ensuring consistent enforcement of privacy regulations across enterprise data sources.

use_cases.title: Legal Intake & Routing Agent
use_cases.description: AI agent that chats with new clients, extracts structured case details, prioritizes based on urgency/value, and routes them to the right legal team for faster response.
key_features: Automated client intake interviews
Case detail structuring and extraction
Priority scoring and routing
Team specialization matching
use_cases.impact: Reduces client intake time, improves case routing accuracy, and enhances client satisfaction.

use_cases.title: AI Biller & Timekeeper Agent
use_cases.description: AI-powered billing and time-tracking platform that transforms natural language work logs into validated time entries, automated billing calculations, invoice generation, and business analytics. Built using Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure OpenAI, FastAPI, and React with a multi-agent workflow for end-to-end financial operations automation.
key_features: Natural language to structured time-entry conversion
Multi-agent workflow orchestration using Microsoft Agent Framework
Automated time validation and billable-hours classification
Real-time billing calculations with tax and discount handling
Professional invoice generation with automated numbering and payment terms
Revenue analytics, utilization tracking, and performance insights
Modern React dashboard with FastAPI backend integration
use_cases.impact: Streamlines billing and timekeeping operations by eliminating manual timesheet entry, automating invoice creation, improving billing accuracy, and providing actionable business insights through AI-driven workflow automation.

domains.description: AI-powered tools that accelerate software engineering workflows — from code migration and generation to automated testing, DevOps, and synthetic data. These solutions boost developer productivity and streamline the entire SDLC.

use_cases.title: CertyFAST
use_cases.description: Streamlining Power BI model development with automated error detection, DAX measure formatting, and simplified documentation, ensuring top-notch quality and adherence to best practices in enterprises.
key_features: Insights: automated standards scanning flags gaps in size, performance, and usability
Insights: custom organization-specific rules, exportable as shareable JSON
Insights: suppress items with a documented rationale that persists in exports
Insights: per-rule guidance with description, resolution steps, and impact area
Lineage: dependency mapping from raw tables through to report visuals, in graph or grid view
Lineage: unused-field detection for every column and measure not used anywhere in the model
Lineage: node properties pane with full metadata for any selected node
Documentation: one-click auto-generated docs for the semantic model and visuals
Documentation: deep coverage of measures, conditional-formatting rules, and upstream sources
Documentation: shareable output exported to Excel or PDF
CPU Statistics: bottleneck detection for visuals and pages consuming the most Server Engine CPU
CPU Statistics: capacity-impact analysis on premium capacity utilization
Scorecard: consolidated compliance score grouped by category or impact area
Scorecard: custom absolute or relative scoring with a configurable maximum per rule
Accessibility: automated checks for tab order, alt text, data labels, titles, tooltips, color blindness, and contrast
Accessibility: coverage aligned to WCAG, AA, and ADA standards with severity grouping
Copilot Readiness: detects schema issues, ambiguous definitions, filter misuse, and missing descriptions
Copilot Readiness: flags unused fields, hierarchy gaps, and naming inconsistencies for prioritized remediation
use_cases.impact: CertyFAST brings measurable governance to enterprise Power BI development. Automated, shareable rule scanning enforces consistent quality and standards across the portfolio, while CPU and capacity analysis pinpoints performance bottlenecks and controls premium capacity cost. Instant impact analysis and lineage produce leaner models, one-click documentation saves hours of manual effort with shareable Excel/PDF output, and accessibility audits keep reports aligned to WCAG, AA, and ADA. Copilot-readiness checks prepare semantic models for AI by surfacing schema and naming issues with prioritized remediation.

use_cases.title: MigrateFAST
use_cases.description: MigrateFAST is an enterprise-grade desktop application engineered to automate the end-to-end migration of Business Intelligence (BI) reports from legacy platforms (Tableau, SAP BO, SAP Crystal etc.) to modern Power BI.
key_features: Metadata extraction from legacy BI reports
AI-assisted DAX conversion
Semantic similarity scoring
Automated model and report creation (PBIP)
use_cases.impact: The platform reduces manual, error-prone migration workflows by combining intelligent metadata extraction, AI-assisted DAX conversion, semantic similarity scoring, and automated model and report creation.

use_cases.title: EmbedFAST
use_cases.description: A secure and scalable solution for seamlessly embedding Power BI into applications, enabling faster analytics adoption with simplified management and customization.
key_features: Power BI embedding
Bookmarks
Exports
Excel exports up to 1 million rows
Subscriptions
Edit semantic model
Create paginated reports
Tenant isolation
Folder structure
Access management
Branding customizations
Report themes
Report templates

use_cases.description: Pre-Sales Agent is an AI-powered RFP workspace for pre-sales and bid teams. It ingests client RFPs and RFIs (PDF, text, markdown), parses and indexes them for retrieval, and runs a structured analysis
key_features: Document intake & analysis

Modular initial analysis: company profile, problem/objectives, scope, requirements, timeline, commercial risks, capability gaps

Final structured proposal draft (20-section format) from RFP + clarifications + credentials + repository context
Workflow & visibility

Session activity timeline with timestamps and status labels (ongoing/completed)
Resumable sessions across days; sidebar status for all past analyses
use_cases.impact:
For pre-sales teams: Cuts time from raw RFP to first structured draft by automating parsing, section-wise analysis, and draft generation instead of starting from a blank page.

For managers: Session timeline and status labels give visibility into multi-day deals — who is waiting on client clarifications, what stage each RFP is in, and a full audit trail of edits and uploads.

For the organization: The Proposal Repository builds reusable institutional knowledge; keyword matching reuses patterns from winning proposals without copying content.

Business outcome: Faster, more consistent RFP responses, fewer missed requirements or deadlines, and clearer handoffs when work spans days or people — aligned with how real pre-sales work actually runs.

use_cases.title: CodeGuardian
use_cases.description: AI-powered pull request reviewer for Azure DevOps, built on Microsoft Agent Framework. Multi-agent pipeline reviews logic, security, and tests, then posts inline comments, scores, and pass/fail status.

Runs natively as an Azure Pipelines PR stage with inline comments and pass/fail status checks
Flexible LLM backends — GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible SLM, switched via one environment variable
Real static analysis tooling — mypy, flake8, pytest, sqlfluff, yamllint, shellcheck, and hadolint

Anti-gaming controls — reopens prematurely resolved AI comment threads and tracks review iterations
Organization and repository-level preference layers with persistent project memory for context-aware reviews

use_cases.impact: CodeGuardian automates first-pass PR review across Azure DevOps, cutting manual reviewer effort and turnaround time while enforcing consistent security, testing, and code-quality standards. It is designed to assist developers in maintaining AI prompts that adhere to Responsible AI principles. By automating the review and update processes, it helps ensure that AI interactions are safe, ethical, and aligned with best practices, ultimately enhancing the reliability and trustworthiness of AI systems.

By automating resume parsing, semantic AI matching, and explainable candidate scoring, it dramatically reduces screening effort while improving hiring consistency and transparency. Campus drives operate end-to-end with automated outreach, personalized assessments, and AI-powered shortlisting. Five specialized AI agents collaborate to deliver explainable and bias-reduced hiring decisions, while a secure desktop-based proctoring solution ensures exam integrity beyond browser-based alternatives. The result is a faster, fairer, and highly scalable recruitment platform designed for enterprise hiring teams.
